description: Did the analyst verify KYC/CDD data on file was current, complete, and consistent with the alert?
Was the customer's risk rating accurate given current activity, or flagged for re-rating if not?
Did the analyst correctly identify all relevant suspicious activity indicators in the alert?
Is the analytical rationale, evidence reviewed, and conclusion clearly documented in the case file?
Where warranted, did the analyst request additional customer information (RFI) — and was that decision justified either way?
Was negative news screening conducted and any hits properly evaluated and documented?
Was the decision to escalate (or not escalate) the case correctly made and executed?
Does the documented evidence actually support the analyst's closure/escalation decision?
